title: T-09 is drawn inside the fire truck access lane — not counted toward greening
why: The canopy's centre lies inside the area labelled 'FIRE TRUCK ACCESS LANE — KEEP CLEAR': a tree there blocks a lane the drawing says to keep clear, so it is left out of the greening count until the designer moves it or the architect accepts it. If the architect confirms this strip is fire-truck rescue space under §299, the requirement drops to 278.8 kgCO2e/yr — still a fail — and the tree fix becomes +7. Until then the greening check keeps Ap = 0 (required 297.0), as the drawings do not declare it.

citation.article: Building Technical Regulations, Design and Construction Part, Art. 299
citation.gloss: Minimum greening area = (site area − area where greening is impracticable) × the legal open-space ratio. An area counts as impracticable only when the architect declares it as one of the kinds the article names (fire-truck rescue space recognised by the fire authority, sports fields, arcades, private and in-site roads, existing lanes); a label on a landscape sheet does not make it one.

title: Greening (Art. 302): required 297.0, provided 197.1 (241.9 before the tree-pit rule) — fail · 7 trees counted, T-08 to confirm
why: 7 Camphor counted (closed outlines, geometry); T-08, which Muse Spark reads as one more tree, counts once a person confirms it (8 then). Required TCO2c = 0.5 × A′ 900.0 m² × β 0.66 = 297.0; provided (ΣGi·Ai 246.4) × α 0.8 = 197.1 kgCO2e/yr. Lawn counted as 180 m², not 200: 20 m² lies under Grass pavers on L-3 (the overlap check): left out of the greening sum until the designer says which is built. One tree species (Camphor), so ra = 0 and α = 0.8. Fixes: +8 Camphor, the same species → 299.52; Change 1 Camphor to Bischofia, a second native species (α → 1.30); no extra trees → 320.32; +249.8 m² of shrub bed (Gi 0.5) → 297.04; Keep EX-01 (Camphor, DBH 95 cm) instead of removing it: an old tree kept by the design counts 2 × its 28.27 m² canopy (+84.8 to ΣGi·Ai), if the basement leaves its root zone in natural ground → 264.96.

citation.article: Building Technical Regulations, Design and Construction Part, Art. 302
citation.gloss: The planting's total carbon fixation must exceed ½ × minimum greening area × β (β 0.66 for an ordinary site).

title: Water retention (Art. 305): λ 0.011 < λc 0.30 over the basement slab — fails on the drawings' own areas
why: λ = Q′ / Q0 must exceed λc = 0.5 × (1 − 0.4) = 0.30. Q0 = A0 1,500 m² × f 1e-05 m/s × t 86,400 s = 1,296 m³ (f: the subsoil is not on the drawings; fill soil's 1e-05 m/s, table 2 note 1). Measured: planted 356.6 m² (7 tree pits × 2.25 m²; Duranta band 10.8 m²; Azalea 150 m²; Lawn 180 m²), permeable paving 248 m²; not permeable: Exposed aggregate 48 m². Planting over the basement slab (the title block says ARTIFICIAL GROUND): Q3 = 0.05 × V3 = 0.05 × 356.6 m² × 0.6 m = 10.7 m³ (soil counted to the 0.6 m maximum; the beds' depth is not on the drawings); the pavers' infiltration term needs natural ground below, so only their base counts: 0.05 × h 0.25 m × 248 m² = 3.1 m³ (h at the 0.25 m maximum; no base thickness is drawn). λ = 0.011 — below 0.30 even in this most favourable reading. On natural ground the same areas would give Q1 = 308.1 m³ and Q2 = 110.2 m³, λ = 0.323. Ask the architect for the subsoil report, the basement's extent under the landscape and the paving base; an over-slab site usually needs storage (a retention tank or an infiltration trench) to pass.

citation.article: Building Technical Regulations, Design and Construction Part, Art. 305
citation.gloss: The site must keep the original ground's ability to hold and infiltrate rain: its water-retention index must exceed 0.5 × the legal open-space ratio (1 − building coverage).

citations.article: Technical Specification for Building-Site Water Retention Design, point 5.1 and table 1
citations.gloss: λ = Q′ / Q0, Q0 = A0 × f × t (t = 86,400 s). Green space on natural ground: Q1 = A1·f·t. Unit permeable pavers: Q2 = 0.5·A2·f·t + 0.05·h·A2 (h = graded base ≤ 0.25 m; 0 on a concrete base). Garden soil on artificial ground (roof, balcony, ground over a basement): Q3 = 0.05·V3, soil counted to 0.6 m deep.
